PreToolUse.description: Block credentials and secrets from being committed

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(env|key|pem|secret)$|creds\.' && echo 'BLOCKED: attempting to commit sensitive file' && exit 2 || exit 0
echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'rm -rf|DROP TABLE|DROP DATABASE|truncate' && echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command requires manual confirmation' && exit 2 || exit 0

PreToolUse.description: Block writes outside src/ and docs/ during build phase

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qvE '^(src|docs|tests?|__tests__)/' && echo 'BLOCKED: only write to src/, docs/, or tests/' && exit 2 || exit 0

PostToolUse.description: Auto-format every file after write or edit

hooks.command: FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null ;; *.py) black "$FILE" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0

PostToolUse.description: Run lint after every source file write

Stop.description: Run tests before Claude marks any session complete

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); [ "$(echo $INPUT | jq -r '.stop_hook_active' 2>/dev/null)" = 'true' ] && exit 0; npm test --silent 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo 'Tests failed — fix before finishing' && exit 2 || exit 0

SessionStart.description: Inject current git branch into every session context

hooks.command: echo "{\"additionalContext\": \"Current branch: $(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'not a git repo'). Phases complete: $(git log --oneline 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'Phase' || echo 0)\"}"
